title: Trying to store enemy Id in game variable, but it's crashing.

posts.author: EKtheRPGguy
posts.body:
The command I'm using is
$game_variables[17] = $game_troop.members
[0].enemy_id
But, immediately as it's called to store it gives me the error
undefined method 'enemy_id' for [0]:array

posts.author: Roninator2
posts.body:
Where and how are you using that script?
The issue is likely that it is split into two lines at a point where it should not be split.
$game_variables[17] = $game_troop.members[0].enemy_id
This works.

posts.author: EKtheRPGguy
posts.body:
Sorry for my mistake, I copy and pasted directly from the script tab, which has an auto line break, after a certain amount of characters are there. It should be being run as one line.
I am using this script inside of a skill, with a common event inside. It's intended function is to be a sort of check skill, with different flavor text depending on the enemy, and user.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body: then give us a screenshot of the skill, and a screenshot of the console during the error message.

posts.author: Roninator2
posts.body:
EKtheRPGguy said:
I copy and pasted directly from the script tab, which has an auto line break, after a certain amount of characters are there.
Click to expand...
What are you talking about? What script tab? The script editor does not have a line break.
Script commands in the editor for common events or troop pages do have line breaks if you're too long but the code your running is not that long.
The only places that is that short is the script entry for variables and conditional branch. (unless I'm missing something)
Even pasting the full line into the note box for an actor doesn't break it where you have shown it.
$game_variables[17] =
$game_troop.members[0].enemy_id

posts.author: EKtheRPGguy
posts.body: Ron, I changed the script to how you formatted it, and it started working. Thanks!
